wins: Completed high-value reconnaissance tasks quickly, capturing all open service data within first 5 minutes (ep001_step02, ep001_step05)
Generated actionable vulnerability hypotheses for later exploitation phases despite limited success rate (ep001_step08)
fails: Unable to escalate privileges or pivot after initial access, leaving final objectives unmet (ep001_step12, ep001_step15)
Excessive reliance on mentor guidance in configuration stages, indicating lack of autonomous exploitation strategy (10 mentor calls logged)
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough and efficient, but exploitation and persistence phases need strengthening to translate data into mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Exploitation attempts stalled due to missing credential reuse strategy after service enumeration

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts and banner analysis

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP port 80/443 responds with headers containing application data
skill_cards.then_action: Execute HTTP directory/proxy enumeration and fingerprint web app stack

skill_cards.if_condition: When local user accounts detected with default or weak passwords
skill_cards.then_action: Perform credential reuse attempts via Hydra and local sudo checks

memory_ops.reason: Consistently high-quality reconnaissance data enabling downstream hypotheses
